name: Marlin Mail
description: A single-file H5 email client. The loop is triage, not purchase: 10 screens, 22 seeded conversations across 8 folders and 5 labels, multi-select with a bulk action bar, folders vs labels (one folder, many labels), read/unread, starring, snoozing, an undoable move, a three-field compose form and search with field operators (from: / label: / has: / is:).

finish.answer: final answer for question tasks; optional for action tasks

observation.text: engine.a11y(state) — an accessibility tree with #test-ids. Every mail row prints its sender, flags, labels and its own select/star test-ids, so a text-only agent can drive multi-select.
observation.pixels: 390x844 screenshot (browser backend); __ENV__.bounds() maps every test-id to a pixel box
observation.state: engine.snapshot(state) — canonical state plus a derived view. For the verifier only.

world.selection: tapping a mail row opens it normally, but toggles selection while selection mode is on; the avatar is always a select target
world.folders_vs_labels: a message is in exactly one folder and carries any number of labels; Starred and Snoozed are views, not folders
world.undo: a move leaves an UNDO affordance on the toast that survives exactly one step
